title: Mathlib group lifting with explicit operation and adjunct formulas
statement: Let $A,B$ be categories with chosen finite products [def-weil-category-product], terminal objects $*_A,*_B$, and Cartesian braidings (canonical for the group construction and the single-functor transport). Write $U_A,U_B$ for the underlying-object functors. An abelian group object consists of an object with associative commutative binary operation, a unit from the terminal object and an inverse endomorphism satisfying the group laws as equations of morphisms. A commutative ring object has such an additive group structure and a second associative commutative binary operation with unit from the terminal object, distributing over the additive operation. Morphisms commute with all operations. For a finite-product-preserving functor $F:A\to B$, let $\lambda^F_{X,Y}:F(X\times Y)\to F(X)\times F(Y)$ be the canonical product comparison and $\lambda^F_*:F(*_A)\to *_B$ the terminal comparison. Let $L:A\to B$, $R:B\to A$ preserve finite products, and let $L\dashv R$ have hom-bijection $\Phi$, unit $\eta$, counit $\varepsilon$. There exist functors $L^g:\operatorname{AbObj}(A)\to\operatorname{AbObj}(B)$ and $R^g:\operatorname{AbObj}(B)\to\operatorname{AbObj}(A)$, strict equalities $U_BL^g=LU_A$, $U_AR^g=RU_B$ with components $e^L,e^R$, and an adjunction $L^g\dashv R^g$ with hom-bijection $E$, such that for $F=L,R$ and its lift $F^g$ (interchanging the source and target categories for $R$), $e_X\circ m_{F^gX}=F(m_X)\circ(\lambda^F_{X,X})^{-1}\circ(e_X\times e_X)$, $e_X\circ q_{F^gX}=F(q_X)\circ(\lambda^F_*)^{-1}$, $e_X\circ i_{F^gX}=F(i_X)\circ e_X$, where $m,q,i$ are group multiplication, unit, inverse. For every group morphism $f:L^gX\to Y$, $e^R_Y\circ U_A(E(f))=\Phi(U_B(f)\circ(e^L_X)^{-1})$. The lifted unit $u$ and counit $v$ satisfy $R(e^L_X)\circ e^R_{L^gX}\circ U_A(u_X)=\eta_{U_AX}$ and $U_B(v_Y)\circ(e^L_{R^gY})^{-1}\circ L((e^R_Y)^{-1})=\varepsilon_{U_BY}$. For every $\alpha:LU_AX\to U_BY$, there exists $f:L^gX\to Y$ with $U_B(f)\circ(e^L_X)^{-1}=\alpha$ if and only if there exists $g:X\to R^gY$ with $e^R_Y\circ U_A(g)=\Phi(\alpha)$.

proof.text: Install the canonical braidings and the chosen-finite-product braided functor structures. Use Functor.mapCommGrp for both lifts, with reflexive strict forgetful equalities, and Adjunction.mapCommGrp for the lifted adjunction. Rewrite its operations using the canonical product and terminal comparison lemmas. Its unit and counit reduce to the original components with identity maps. Apply the lifted hom-equivalence and its inverse for the final criterion, cancelling with injectivity of the original hom-equivalence.

theorem liftedCommGrpBranch
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [CartesianMonoidalCategory A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [CartesianMonoidalCategory B]
    {L : A ⥤ B} {R : B ⥤ A} (adj : L ⊣ R) [PreservesFiniteProducts L]
    [PreservesFiniteProducts R] :
    let : BraidedCategory A := BraidedCategory.ofCartesianMonoidalCategory
    let : BraidedCategory B := BraidedCategory.ofCartesianMonoidalCategory
    (∃ (LF : CommGrp A ⥤ CommGrp B) (RF : CommGrp B ⥤ CommGrp A)
          (hL : LF ⋙ CommGrp.forget B = CommGrp.forget A ⋙ L)
          (hR : RF ⋙ CommGrp.forget A = CommGrp.forget B ⋙ R),
        let eL := eqToIso hL
        let eR := eqToIso hR
        ∃ (a : LF ⊣ RF),
          (∀ X : CommGrp A,
            MonObj.mul (X := (LF.obj X).X) ≫ eL.hom.app X =
              (eL.hom.app X ⊗ₘ eL.hom.app X) ≫
                (prodComparisonIso L X.X X.X).inv ≫ L.map (MonObj.mul (X := X.X)) ∧
            MonObj.one (X := (LF.obj X).X) ≫ eL.hom.app X =
              (preservesTerminalIso L).inv ≫ L.map (MonObj.one (X := X.X)) ∧
            GrpObj.inv (X := (LF.obj X).X) ≫ eL.hom.app X =
              eL.hom.app X ≫ L.map (GrpObj.inv (X := X.X))) ∧
          (∀ X : CommGrp B,
            MonObj.mul (X := (RF.obj X).X) ≫ eR.hom.app X =
              (eR.hom.app X ⊗ₘ eR.hom.app X) ≫
                (prodComparisonIso R X.X X.X).inv ≫ R.map (MonObj.mul (X := X.X)) ∧
            MonObj.one (X := (RF.obj X).X) ≫ eR.hom.app X =
              (preservesTerminalIso R).inv ≫ R.map (MonObj.one (X := X.X)) ∧
            GrpObj.inv (X := (RF.obj X).X) ≫ eR.hom.app X =
              eR.hom.app X ≫ R.map (GrpObj.inv (X := X.X))) ∧
          (∀ (X : CommGrp A) (Y : CommGrp B) (f : LF.obj X ⟶ Y),
            (CommGrp.forget A).map (a.homEquiv X Y f) ≫ eR.hom.app Y =
              adj.homEquiv X.X Y.X (eL.inv.app X ≫ (CommGrp.forget B).map f)) ∧
          (∀ X : CommGrp A,
            (CommGrp.forget A).map (a.unit.app X) ≫ eR.hom.app (LF.obj X) ≫
                R.map (eL.hom.app X) = adj.unit.app X.X) ∧
          (∀ Y : CommGrp B,
            L.map (eR.inv.app Y) ≫ eL.inv.app (RF.obj Y) ≫
                (CommGrp.forget B).map (a.counit.app Y) = adj.counit.app Y.X) ∧
          (∀ (X : CommGrp A) (Y : CommGrp B) (α : L.obj X.X ⟶ Y.X),
            (∃ f : LF.obj X ⟶ Y, eL.inv.app X ≫ (CommGrp.forget B).map f = α) ↔
              ∃ g : X ⟶ RF.obj Y,
                (CommGrp.forget A).map g ≫ eR.hom.app Y = adj.homEquiv X.X Y.X α))
